d:
The uniform that made her want to earn respect.
We've all had that one moment when someone says something that changes the way we see ourselves.
For her, it was her brother saying that the respect isn't for the person... it's for the uniform.
And instead of taking it the wrong way, she takes it as a challenge.
She decides to join the Indian Army. Not just to wear the uniform, but to work hard enough to earn everything that comes with it — the respect, the pride, and most importantly, the chance to make herself and her family proud.
